name: Store Sales Report For WooCommerce
author: devsoul

sections.description:
The WooCommerce Sales Report Plugin is a powerful tool designed to provide in-depth insights into your store’s sales performance. Whether you need a product sales report for WooCommerce, advanced WooCommerce reporting, or a WooCommerce sales tax report, this plugin simplifies data analysis for better decision-making.

Short Description

Track, analyze, and optimize WooCommerce sales with detailed reports on orders, products, categories, and regions for data-driven decisions

Compatible

  1. Addify Cost Of Goods
  2. Yith Cost Of Goods
  3. Woocommerce Sales Report

Features

  • Sales Analysis for WooCommerce: Track sales trends over different time periods.

  • Sales by Order: View detailed reports on all orders placed.

  • Sales by Product: Analyze revenue generated by specific products.

  • Sales by Specific Category: Get category-wise sales performance reports.

  • WooCommerce Sales Report by Product: Identify best-selling products and low-performing items.

  • WooCommerce Sales Report by User Role: Understand how different user roles contribute to sales.

  • Sales by Country and State: Filter reports by geographical location.

  • WooCommerce Daily Sales Report: Monitor daily revenue and order trends.

  • WooCommerce Sales Tax Report: Generate tax reports based on sales data.

  • Get cost of goods and revenue data through report

  • Hide or Show any column to get your preferred sales data

    Filters Options

  • sale by Order

  • sale by Product
  • Specific Product
  • Specific Category
  • Order Status
  • Select Countries
  • Select States
  • Select Zip Code
  • Generate Sale Tax
  • Generate Daily Sales Report
  • Generate Report by User/ User Role

Want to Try Our Premium Version you can visit below and let us know if anything else in your mind. Email:devsoulofficial@gmail.com

  • WooCommerce Sales Tax Report

Why use this extension

✅ Comprehensive Order Reports

This plugin allows you to generate detailed reports for orders, including information such as order name, order status, order amount, net amount, shipping cost, and more.

✅ Advanced Reporting Options

With this plugin, you have access to various reports covering customers, products, categories, orders, and more, so you can analyze your store’s performance in any way you prefer.

✅ Detailed Product Reports

You can generate complete product reports, including product name, category, and other relevant details.

✅ Category-Based Reports

This powerful reporting tool provides comprehensive reports for product categories, including category name and additional details.

✅ Tax and Refund Reports

Get accurate tax and refund reports instantly, without the need for complex calculations, with just a single click.

✅ Boosting Product Sales

To increase your sales, it’s important to set goals and track progress. This plugin offers advanced reports where you can compare current and past sales to help you develop new strategies for growth.

✅ Customer History Reports

View a complete history of customer interactions in an organized and easy-to-read format with the WooCommerce Reporting plugin.

✅ In-Depth Order Details Reports

Gain detailed insights into customer orders, including customer name, shipping and billing addresses, and more.

✅ Automatic Email Reports

Schedule automatic email reports to receive summaries of your store’s sales at specific times, ensuring you stay informed without any effort.

✅ Advanced Search Filters

With advanced search filters built into the plugin, finding specific reports becomes effortless. For example, you can search for sales of particular products between specified dates and based on custom statuses.

✅ Export Reports to Excel

All sales reports can be exported as Excel files, or you can print them directly for offline use, making it easy to share or analyze your data.

✅ Graphical Reports

For faster analysis and better understanding, the plugin displays sales reports in graph form. You can view data through bar charts and line graphs for quick insights.

✅ Send Instant Sales Reports via Email

Receive instant sales reports directly in your email, providing you with up-to-date information on your store’s performance as soon as it’s available.

✅ Cost of Goods

View detailed cost information for each product to help you understand the profitability of your store.

✅ Revenue Breakdown by Product and Variation

Break down your revenue at the product level, variation level, and across customer tables, product tables, and order tables to analyze where your sales are coming from.

✅ Pie, Column, and Country Charts

Visualize your data with pie charts, column charts, and country-specific charts for a clearer understanding of your sales performance across regions.

✅ Filter Reports by State

Use the state filter to view and analyze reports by specific states, giving you more control over your data and insights.

✅ Filter Reports by City

Gain a more granular view by filtering your reports based on city-specific data.

✅ Filter Reports by Postal/Zip Code

Filter your reports by postal or zip code to understand sales and performance in specific locations.

✅ Order Currency

The plugin also allows you to filter and view reports based on the currency used for each order.

Make Informed Business Decisions

*With advanced WooCommerce reporting, you can identify top-performing products, track sales trends across different geographical locations, and optimize pricing and marketing strategies.

User-Friendly and Customizable

*The plugin offers an intuitive interface, making it easy to filter and customize reports based on your business needs. Whether you want a WooCommerce sales report by user role or a WooCommerce sales tax report, you can generate it with just a few clicks.

How to Use the WooCommerce Sales Report Plugin

Install & Activate: Download the plugin from the WordPress repository and activate it.

Access Sales Reports: Navigate to the WooCommerce Reports section in your dashboard.

Select Report Type: Choose from options such as sales by product, order status, or country.

Filter & Export: Apply custom filters and export data for further analysis.

FAQs

Q: How to get sales report from WooCommerce?

Ans: You can generate a sales report by navigating to WooCommerce > Reports. With our best WooCommerce sales report plugin, you get more advanced reporting options beyond default WooCommerce reports.

Q: How do I report sales by country in WooCommerce?

Ans: Using the WooCommerce Sales Report Plugin, you can filter sales data by country or state to analyze performance across different regions.

Q: How do I track sales in WooCommerce?

Ans: Our advanced WooCommerce reporting feature allows you to track orders, revenue, and sales trends in real time.

Q: How to extract sales data from WooCommerce?

Ans: The plugin allows you to export sales reports in CSV format, making it easy to analyze data in external applications.

Contact US

Email us at: devsoulofficial@gmail.com

  • Feel Free to contact Us for support, installation or customization.

External Dependencies

This plugin uses the Google Charts loader library for chart rendering. The library is hosted on Google’s servers and accessed via the following URL: https://www.gstatic.com/charts/loader.js

Google Charts Loader: Used for chart rendering, hosted on Google’s servers.URL: https://www.gstatic.com/charts/loader.js

Font Awesome: Provides icon fonts for styling and UI enhancements.URL: https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/font-awesome/4.7.0/css/font-awesome.min.css

DataTables CSS: Styles the DataTables for enhanced table functionality.URL: https://cdn.datatables.net/1.11.5/css/jquery.dataTables.min.css

DataTables JS: Adds interactive table features such as sorting and pagination. URL: https://cdn.datatables.net/1.11.5/js/jquery.dataTables.min.js
sections.installation:
Download the .zip file.
Go to: WordPress Admin > Plugins > Add New and Upload Plugin with the file you downloaded with Choose File.
Install Now and Activate the extension.

You can also visit devsouls.store
